en.title: This Pigeon Wears a Lace Crown. Can You Name It?
en.description: The Victoria crowned pigeon is regarded as the largest living pigeon. Its lace-like blue crest is tipped with white, and it spends most of its time on the forest floor looking for fallen fruit.
